outlooks.summary: WIDESPREAD THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY WILL FORM ON THURSDAY ALONG A COLD FRONT MOVING EASTWARD ACROSS THE SOUTHERN AND CENTRAL PLAINS INTO THE MIDDLE MISSISSIPPI AND EVENTUALLY TENNESSEE VALLEY REGIONS. THE STRONGER THUNDERSTORMS WILL LIKELY PRODUCE STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL. GREATEST LARGE HAIL THREAT WILL EXIST FROM EASTERN OKLAHOMA INTO THE ARKLATEX AND OZARKS.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A PROGRESSIVE UPPER TROUGH WILL ADVANCE THROUGH THE PLAINS AND MS VALLEY REGION THURSDAY. A STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH EMBEDDED WITHIN THE UPPER TROUGH BASE WILL CONTINUE THROUGH OK THURSDAY AFTERNOON BEFORE REACHING THE LOWER-MID MS VALLEY DURING THE EVENING. A COLD FRONT WILL ACCOMPANY THE SYNOPTIC TROUGH AND SHOULD EXTEND FROM THE UPPER MS VALLEY SWWD THROUGH WRN OK AND WRN TX 12Z THURSDAY. A WEAK CYCLONE IS FORECAST TO DEVELOP AND SHIFT NWD ALONG THIS BOUNDARY THROUGH THE MID MS VALLEY INTO THE GREAT LAKES...WHILE THE FRONT ADVANCES EAST...REACHING THE OH AND TN VALLEYS BY THE END OF THIS PERIOD. A CONVECTIVELY REINFORCED WARM FRONT CURRENTLY FROM MO INTO IL MAY LIFT SLIGHTLY NWD AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT.

sections.title: SRN PLAINS INTO THE LOWER-MIDDLE MS VALLEY REGIONS
sections.text: AXIS OF RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WITH UPPER 60S-70F DEWPOINTS WILL ADVECT NEWD THROUGH THE PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR ALONG A /30-40 KT/ SWLY LLJ AND BENEATH MODEST 6.5-7C/KM MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. THE WARM SECTOR SHOULD DESTABILIZE AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER WARMS DURING THE DAY...BOOSTING MLCAPE TO 2000 J/KG FROM NERN TX AND ERN OK INTO THE LOWER-MID MS VALLEY. ELEVATED STORMS WILL LIKELY BE ONGOING ALONG WARM CONVEYOR BELT FROM OK INTO ERN KS AS WELL AS ALONG AND NORTH OF THE BOUNDARY ACROSS CNTRL/NRN MO. HOWEVER...THE PRIMARY ZONE OF THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED AS DEEP ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ACCOMPANYING COLD FRONT INTERACTS WITH THE DESTABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER FROM ERN KS INTO CNTRL OK AND SWD INTO NCNTRL AND CNTRL TX. WIND PROFILES ARE FORECAST TO BE MOSTLY UNIDIRECTIONAL DURING THE DAY...LIMITING THE SIZE OF LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS. HOWEVER...DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL INCREASE TO 40 KT WITH THE APPROACH OF THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH SUPPORTING POTENTIAL FOR ORGANIZED STORMS. sections.text: THE LARGE-SCALE TROUGH MOVING THROUGH THE CNTRL U.S. WILL UNDERGO FURTHER AMPLIFICATION DURING THE DAY ONE PERIOD IN RESPONSE TO THE PROGRESSION OF MID AND UPPER-LEVEL JET STREAKS FROM THE CANADIAN AND NRN U.S. ROCKIES INTO THE CNTRL PLAINS. AT THE SURFACE...AN ELONGATED AREA OF LOW PRESSURE FROM N-CNTRL OK INTO NERN KS WILL DEEPEN SLIGHTLY WHILE DEVELOPING INTO THE UPPER GREAT LAKES ALONG A COLD FRONT SURGING EWD THROUGH THE MIDWEST. THE STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO ORGANIZE INTO LINES THIS AFTERNOON INTO THIS EVENING. THE MORE INTENSE CELLS WILL LIKELY PRODUCE DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL. A FEW TORNADOES MAY ALSO OCCUR. THE GREATEST SEVERE THREAT WILL EXTEND FROM NORTHEAST TEXAS AND EASTERN OKLAHOMA INTO ARKANSAS AND SOUTHERN MISSOURI. SEVERAL CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE OUTLOOK AT 20Z. THE FIRST CHANGE IS TO REMOVE THE 30 PERCENT HAIL PROBABILITY FROM THE SLIGHT RISK AREA. SHORT-TERM MODELS MOVE THE STORMS CURRENTLY ONGOING IN ERN OK AND NORTH TX EWD AWAY FROM THE STEEPER MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OVER THE NEXT 2 TO 4 HOURS. THIS SHOULD RESULT IN A GRADUAL DECREASE IN THE HAIL THREAT THROUGH EARLY THIS EVENING. THE SECOND CHANGE TO THE OUTLOOK IS TO REMOVE THE SLIGHT RISK AREA FROM PARTS OF CNTRL OK AND SE KS TO THE WEST OF THE ONGOING CONVECTION WHERE A COLD FRONT IS ADVECTING DRIER AND MORE STABLE AIR. outlooks.summary: NUMEROUS STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS FROM EASTERN TEXAS THROUGH THE LOWER AND MIDDLE MISSISSIPPI VALLEYS WILL CONTINUE EAST INTO THE TENNESSEE AND OHIO VALLEYS THIS EVENING AND OVERNIGHT. DAMAGING WIND WILL REMAIN THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH THE STRONGER STORMS...BUT SOME LARGE HAIL MAY OCCUR...ESPECIALLY FROM TEXAS INTO THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY AREA. A COUPLE OF TORNADOES REMAIN POSSIBLE THIS EVENING MAINLY FROM ARKANSAS INTO NORTHERN MISSISSIPPI...WESTERN AND MIDDLE TENNESSEE AND WESTERN KENTUCKY.

sections.title: LOWER-MIDDLE MS THROUGH TN AND OH VALLEY AREAS
sections.text: EXPANSIVE SQUALL LINE CONTINUES FROM SOUTHEASTERN MO SWWD THROUGH CNTRL ARKANSAS AND NERN-CNTRL TX. THESE STORMS WILL DEVELOP EAST INTO THE OVERNIGHT SUPPORTED BY STRONG FORCING ACCOMPANYING A PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ATTENDANT LLJ THAT IS FORECAST TO STRENGTHEN TO 50+ KT FROM THE LOWER MS VALLEY INTO THE TN AND OH VALLEYS OVERNIGHT. STORMS WITHIN THE LINE SHOULD REMAIN NEAR PEAK INTENSITY AS THEY CONTINUE THROUGH THE MOIST/INSTABILITY AXIS NEXT COUPLE HOURS. GIVEN THE PREDOMINANT LINEAR MODE...THE PRIMARY THREAT REMAINS DAMAGING WIND. HOWEVER...THE LLJ IS IN THE PROCESS OF STRENGTHENING WITH 0-2 KM HODOGRAPHS BECOMING LARGER WITH TIME. THEREFORE...SOME THREAT FOR A COUPLE OF TORNADOES EXISTS WITH ANY STORM THAT CAN DEVELOP AHEAD OF THE LINE OR POSSIBLY WITH SUPERCELL STRUCTURES EMBEDDED WITHIN THE LINE. OVERALL WEAKENING MAY OCCUR LATER THIS EVENING AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER BEGINS TO STABILIZE...BUT THE THREAT FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO WILL CONTINUE WELL INTO THE OVERNIGHT.

sections.title: SCNTRL AND SERN TX
sections.text: DEEPER/STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ATTENDANT LLJ WILL REMAIN NORTH OF TX. NEVERTHELESS...THE 00Z RAOBS FROM CORPUS CHRISTI AND LAKE CHARLES SHOW ONLY WEAK CAPPING...AND FORCING ALONG THE SWD ADVANCING COLD FRONT MAY BE ENOUGH TO SUSTAIN THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT THROUGH SCNTRL AND SERN TX WHERE THE ATMOSPHERE REMAINS VERY MOIST AND STRONGLY UNSTABLE. STORMS IN THIS REGION WILL REMAIN CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL THIS EVENING. ..DIAL.. 10/03/2014

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POSSIBILITY FOR A FEW STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS POTENTIALLY CAPABLE OF AN ISOLD LARGE HAIL THREAT THIS MORNING. STORM COVERAGE AND INTENSITY IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE THROUGH THE EARLY AFTERNOON AND A GREATER SEVERE THREAT IN THE FORM OF ISOLD LARGE HAIL/DMGG WINDS IS ANTICIPATED. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED ACROSS A PORTION OF THE AREA BY LATE MORNING OR EARLY AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS A VIGOROUS SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING EWD THROUGH THE SRN HIGH PLAINS THIS MORNING WITH THIS FEATURE FORECAST OVER CNTRL OK BY LATE AFTERNOON. INCREASING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS DISTURBANCE AND DIURNAL HEATING/DESTABILIZATION WILL FOSTER A GRADUAL INCREASE IN THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE AND THE TRANSITION FROM SUB-SEVERE STORMS DURING THE MID-MORNING TO ISOLD SEVERE BY LATE THIS MORNING INTO THE AFTERNOON. VEERING AND STRENGTHENING FLOW WITH HEIGHT PER KTLX/KINX/KSRX VAD DATA WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORM STRUCTURES INCLUDING SUPERCELLS AND SMALL SCALE BOWS. THE INITIAL ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY REMAIN NON-LINEAR AND POSE PRIMARILY AN ISOLD LARGE HAIL RISK AND LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE THREAT AS LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES STEEPEN THROUGH THE EARLY AFTERNOON AND STORMS BECOME SURFACE-BASED. MODELS SHOW A GRADUAL INCREASE IN THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE WITH A COALESCING OF STORMS INTO A LINEAR CONFIGURATION ALONG THE FRONT WITH TIME BY LATER THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH INCREASINGLY NUMEROUS STORMS DURING THE AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BETWEEN AREAS OF SCATTERED ELEVATED STORMS WITHIN THE WARM CONVEYOR BELT OF THE BROADER CNTRL CONUS CYCLONE...POCKETS OF STRONGER SURFACE HEATING HAVE YIELDED TEMPERATURES WARMING INTO THE LOWER TO MIDDLE 80S. WITH THIS OCCURRING AMIDST A RICHLY MOIST GULF AIR MASS....CHARACTERIZED BY UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S SURFACE DEW POINTS...MODIFIED 12Z SGF/LZK/JAN RAOBS SUGGEST THE AIR MASS HAS BECOME AT LEAST MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH NEGLIGIBLE INHIBITION. BOUNDARY-LAYER CU APPEARS TO BE INCREASINGLY AGITATED/CLUMPING FROM THE OZARKS ACROSS THE MID-MS VALLEY...INFERRING THAT STORM DEVELOPMENT COULD BECOME WIDESPREAD BY MID-AFTERNOON. ALTHOUGH DEEP-LAYER WINDS WILL BE GRADUALLY STRENGTHENING FROM THE WEST...THEY SHOULD REMAIN MODEST AND SUPPORT A MORE ISOLATED/MARGINAL SEVERE RISK RELATIVE TO FARTHER SW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON ALONG A COLD FRONT AS IT MOVES EWD THROUGH THE REGION. THE STRONGER STORMS WILL POTENTIALLY BE CAPABLE OF AN ISOLD LARGE HAIL AND STRONG/LOCALLY SEVERE WIND GUST THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY DURING THE PAST HOUR HAS SHOWN THE DEVELOPMENT OF AN AGITATED CU FIELD NEAR THE FRONT FROM PALO PINTO COUNTY NEWD INTO MONTAGUE/COOK COUNTIES. RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE SAMPLED BY THE 12Z FWD RAOB EXHIBITED A LOWEST 100-MB MEAN MIXING RATIO NEAR 15 G/KG BENEATH A CAPPING INVERSION. MODIFYING THE OBSERVED SOUNDING AND MODEL FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST TEMPS ABOVE 90 DEG F WILL BE REQUIRED VIA HEATING ALONE IN ORDER TO BREAK THE CAP. HOWEVER...FORCING FOR ASCENT IS FORECAST TO INCREASE THIS AFTERNOON IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE EWD PROGRESSION OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS AND WILL RESULT IN THE INCREASING PROBABILITY FOR SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM INITIATION. EFFECTIVE SHEAR AOA 35 KT AND MODERATE TO STRONG BUOYANCY WILL PROMOTE ISOLD LARGE HAIL GROWTH WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS...IN ADDITION TO A LOCALIZED STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUST RISK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW WEAK TRANSIENT SUPERCELLS EMBEDDED WITHIN SCATTERED STORMS ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY COULD PRODUCE A BRIEF TORNADO AND/OR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WITHIN A LOW-LEVEL WAA REGIME AND TROPICAL MOISTURE PLUME...SCATTERED CONVECTION HAS PERSISTED ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY. A COUPLE OF STORMS CENTERED OVER CARROLL AND HOLMES COUNTY MS EXHIBITED WEAK DISCRETE SUPERCELL STRUCTURE THIS PAST HOUR. AREA VWP DATA INDICATE MODEST LOW-LEVEL VEERING WITH 0-3 KM SHEAR OF 15-20 KT. WITH FLOW NOT EXPECTED TO SUBSTANTIALLY INCREASE UNTIL THIS EVENING...KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT SHOULD REMAIN RELATIVELY MARGINAL FOR SUSTAINING THE AMPLITUDE/LONGEVITY OF SUPERCELLS. STILL...AMIDST MEAN MIXING RATIOS OF 16-18 G/KG PER REGIONAL RAOBS...LOCALLY WET MICROBURSTS AND EVEN A BRIEF TORNADO ARE WITHIN THE REALM OF POSSIBILITY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GREATEST SEVERE RISK WITHIN WW 517 WILL PROBABLY EVOLVE OUT OF A LINE SEGMENT SW OF THE ST LOUIS METRO AREA WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND EVEN A TORNADO POSSIBLE INTO EARLY EVENING. FARTHER E...STORMS SHOULD PROGRESS E OF WW 517 INTO PARTS OF SW IND WITH A GENERALLY MARGINAL/ISOLATED SEVERE RISK...THAT MIGHT RENDER A POSSIBLE WW ISSUANCE BEYOND 21Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SHORT-LINE SEGMENT HAD RECENTLY CONSOLIDATED AND ACCELERATED ACROSS FRANKLIN/CRAWFORD COUNTY MO WITHIN THE PORTION OF THE LINE THAT IS MORE PERPENDICULAR TO THE MEAN FLOW. ALTHOUGH STL VWP DATA IS NOISY...STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR EXISTS ALONG/N OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY CENTERED FROM WASHINGTON COUNTY MO TO FAYETTE COUNTY IL AS OF 20Z. THIS SHOULD CONTINUE TO SUPPORT EMBEDDED LEWP/BOWING STRUCTURES WITH STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS. FARTHER E...LEAD CONVECTIVE CLUSTER APPROACHING THE WABASH VALLEY IS EVOLVING ALONG THE EDGE OF THE RICH GULF MOISTURE PLUME AND THE FRINGE OF STRONG MID-LEVEL SWLYS. THE CHARACTER OF THIS CONVECTION HAS NOT APPEARED OVERLY FAVORABLE FOR ORGANIZED SEVERE. BUT WITH RELATIVELY DEEPLY MIXED THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES WITH TEMPERATURES HAVING WARMED INTO THE MIDDLE TO UPPER 80S...STRONG WIND GUSTS CAPABLE OF LOCALIZED DAMAGING WINDS ARE POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND LOCALIZED DAMAGING WIND GUST RISK WILL CONTINUE THIS AFTERNOON AS A MIX MODE OF SUPERCELLS AND ORGANIZED BROKEN LINE SEGMENTS AFFECTS MAINLY PORTIONS OF ERN OK...WRN AND NWRN AR...AND PERHAPS FAR SWRN AND FAR S-CNTRL MO. SEVERE POTENTIAL IS CONSIDERABLY LESS OVER MUCH OF CNTRL AND SWRN MO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC IMAGERY AT 2015Z SHOWS SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS...SOME OF WHICH ARE STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE. SEVERAL STORMS EXHIBITING WEAK SUPERCELL STRUCTURE HAVE BEEN NOTED ACROSS ERN PORTIONS OF OK AND NWRN AR. THE AIRMASS IMMEDIATELY NEAR AND DOWNSTREAM OF THESE STORMS HAS LARGELY BEEN UNDISTURBED BY PRIOR CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW AND ASSOCIATED STABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER EFFECTS. AS THE MID TO UPPER TROUGH CONTINUES TO PIVOT EWD OVER THE PLAINS DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS...FORCING FOR ASCENT AND EFFECTIVE SHEAR SHOULD MAXIMIZE AND PROMOTE AN ORGANIZED THREAT FOR ISOLD SEVERE STORMS. FARTHER N...SURFACE ANALYSIS DEPICTS AN OLD FRONTAL ZONE INVOF THE NWRN AR/SWRN MO BORDER REGION WITH AN ARCING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AND ASSOCIATED LEADING EDGE OF THE ASSOCIATED COLD POOL LOCATED OVER THE OZARKS. S OF THE BOUNDARY A MOIST/MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS WILL MAINTAIN AN ISOLD STRONG TO SEVERE HAIL/LOCALIZED DMGG WIND THREAT. THE STABILIZING INFLUENCE OF EARLIER DAY CLOUD COVER/RAIN INTO THE COOL SIDE OF THE BOUNDARY WILL LIKELY LIMIT STORM INTENSITY AND THE PROSPECTS FOR ISOLD SEVERE AS STORMS MOVE EWD/NEWD INTO SRN-CNTRL MO DURING THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. ..SMITH.. 10/02/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LINE OF SVR TSTMS WILL CONTINUE EWD ACROSS N TX WITH THE SVR THREAT PERSISTING. PRIMARY SVR THREAT WITH THIS LINE IS SVR WINDS...SOME POTENTIALLY IN EXCESS OF 65 KT. FARTHER S...UPSCALE GROWTH OF ONGOING MULTI-CELLULAR ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED WITH A RESULTANT SVR HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT SURFACE OBSERVATIONS THROUGHOUT THE METROPLEX HAVE MEASURED WIND GUSTS FROM 40 TO 60 KT AS THE LINE OF STORMS MOVED THROUGH. SURFACE ANALYSIS REVEALS PRESSURE FALLS GREATER THAN 2 MB IN 2 HOURS AHEAD OF THE LINE. ADDITIONALLY...SLIGHT BACKING IN THE WINDS WAS NOTED AT CRS...LNC AND TRL. THESE FACTORS SUGGEST SOME LARGER-SCALE ORGANIZATION ONGOING WITH THIS LINE. OVERALL DOWNSTREAM ENVIRONMENT IS CHARACTERIZED BY TEMPERATURES IN THE LOW 90S AND DEWPOINTS IN THE MID TO UPPER 60S WITH MLCAPE ESTIMATED NEAR 2000 J PER KG. CURRENT EXPECTATION IS FOR THE LINE TO CONTINUE EWD WITH PERHAPS SOME ACCELERATION. AS SUCH...DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL REMAIN THE PRIMARY SVR THREAT WITH SOME WIND GUSTS IN EXCESS OF 65 KT POSSIBLE. FARTHER S /ACROSS CNTRL TX/...SWLY SURFACE WINDS ARE CONTRIBUTING TO WEAK CONVERGE ALONG COLD FRONT WITH TSTM ACTIVITY CURRENTLY MULTI-CELLULAR. HOWEVER...SOME SLIGHT BACKING OF THE SURFACE WINDS WAS NOTED AT GTO AND HLR. CURRENT EXPECTATION IS FOR CONVERGENCE ALONG THE LINE TO INCREASE WITH A RESULTANT INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE/INTENSITY AND EVENTUAL UPSCALE GROWTH INTO LINE CONNECTED TO THE ACTIVITY IN N TX. SOME HAIL IS POSSIBLE WITH THE ONGOING MULTI-CELL STORMS WITH AN EVENTUAL TRANSITION TO PRIMARILY A DAMAGING WIND THREAT AS THE LINE CONSOLIDATES AND MOVES EWD. ..MOSIER.. 10/02/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WEATHER THREAT IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE FROM WEST TO EAST AS A DEVELOPING QLCS ADVANCES EWD INTO THE EVENING ACROSS AR/NRN LA AND SRN PARTS OF MO INTO THE LOWER MS/TN VALLEYS REGION. A NEW WW WILL BE COORDINATED WITH THE AFFECTED WFOS FROM NRN LA/AR TO SERN MO/WRN KY. MEANWHILE...ONGOING STORMS FROM MS TO FAR NERN AR/ADJACENT WRN TN WILL CONTINUE TO POSE AN ISOLATED SEVERE WEATHER THREAT THROUGH 00Z. THEREAFTER...CONCERN EXISTS FOR AN INCREASED TORNADO THREAT ACROSS THE MID-SOUTH INTO THE MID-EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOISTURE-CHANNEL IMAGERY SUGGESTED A CORRIDOR OF DEEP LAYER ASCENT HAD BEGUN TO OVERTAKE THE EASTWARD-MOVING LINE OF TSTMS...WHICH EXTEND FROM NORTH-CENTRAL TX THROUGH ERN OK TO SWRN-CENTRAL MO. TRENDS IN MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY INDICATED COLD-POOL MERGERS WITH THE BROKEN LINE OF STORMS WERE COALESCING AS LINEAR FORCING BECOMES THE PREDOMINANT FACTOR FOR STORMS INTO THE EVENING...WITH THE ENEWD TRACK OF THE SRN PLAINS SHORTWAVE TROUGH. MEANWHILE...A W/NWWD MOVING COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...FROM ONGOING AND EARLIER SPLITTING STORMS ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY...EXTENDED FROM NWRN LA /EAST OF SHV/ NWD INTO SWRN AR AND THEN NEWD THROUGH CENTRAL AR NEAR LIT TO NERN AR/WRN TN INVOF THE ONGOING STORMS. ALTHOUGH VISIBLE IMAGERY INDICATED CLEAR SKIES IN THE WAKE OF THAT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...RECENT TRENDS IN SURFACE OBSERVATIONS INDICATED RISING TEMPERATURES/DEW POINTS LIKELY IN RESPONSE TO MASS FIELDS/ATMOSPHERIC ADJUSTMENTS WITH THE APPROACH OF THE STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH. A FURTHER INCREASE IN DEEP-LAYER AND LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IS EXPECTED ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA THROUGH THE EVENING...WITHIN A RATHER MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. WHILE DAMAGING WINDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE A THREAT WITH ANY STORMS...ESPECIALLY WITH THE EWD MOVING QLCS...A STRENGTHENING SSWLY LLJ FROM THE ARKLATEX TO LOWER TN VALLEY WILL SUPPORT AN INCREASING TORNADO THREAT THROUGH THE EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: OVERALL SVR THREAT APPEARS TO BE DIMINISHING BUT STRONG TO ISOLATED SVR STORMS ARE STILL POSSIBLE FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS ACROSS WW 517.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT RADAR IMAGERY ACROSS E-CNTRL MO AND CNTRL IL REVEALS LOOSELY ORGANIZED...MULTI-CELLULAR CONVECTION WITH UPDRAFT INTENSIFICATION RESULTANT FROM CELL MERGERS AS THE PRIMARY SVR THREAT. THE ONLY EXCEPTION IS ACROSS REYNOLDS COUNTY MO WHERE A BOWING SEGMENT HAS RECENTLY SHOWN SIGNS OF ORGANIZATION AND INTENSIFICATION. MULTI-CELLULAR ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY CONTINUE ACROSS THE WATCH AREA FOR THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO BEFORE SLIGHTLY MORE ORGANIZED CONVECTION REACHES WRN PORTIONS OF THE WATCH. GIVEN THE ONGOING ACTIVITY OVER THE AREA...INSTABILITY WILL LIKELY BE LIMITED WHEN THE LINE OF STORMS BEGINS MOVING THROUGH. THIS LIMITED INSTABILITY MAY BE OFFSET BY INCREASING LOW-LEVEL SHEAR AND A RESULTANT INCREASE IN STORM ORGANIZATION. CURRENT THINKING IS THAT THE OVERALL SVR THREAT WILL BE ISOLATED...OWING PRIMARILY TO THE LACK OF INSTABILITY...BUT STORM MERGERS MAY RESULT IN SOME ISOLATED SVR HAIL AND/OR WIND GUSTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WATCH WILL BE COORDINATED FOR PARTS OF EAST AND SOUTHEAST TX INTO LA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN MOSAIC RADAR AND VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWED A NARROW BAND OF WEAK REFLECTIVITY/CU IN SOUTHEAST TO EAST CENTRAL TX. THIS BAND WAS DETECTED ALONG A LOW-LEVEL CONFLUENCE ZONE EXTENDING FROM LIVE OAK COUNTY NNEWD THROUGH GONZALES AND BASTROP COUNTIES. MEANWHILE...THE MILAM AND ROBERTSON COUNTIES PORTION OF THIS SAME BOUNDARY HAS HAD GREATER WNWWD MOVEMENT DUE TO A NWD MOVING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM AN EARLIER STORM IN FAYETTE COUNTY TX. RADAR IMAGERY ALSO SHOWED A BROKEN LINE OF STORMS EXTENDING FROM THE ARKLATEX SWWD TO THE SRN PORTION OF WW 518. THE ENVIRONMENT EAST OF THE BROKEN LINE OF STORMS REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE WHILE STRENGTHENING WSWLY MIDLEVEL WINDS/EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR ACROSS EAST/SOUTHEAST TX/LA AS THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH TRACKS TOWARD THE MID-SOUTH WILL SUPPORT A CONTINUED LIKELIHOOD FOR ORGANIZED STORMS FROM WEST TO EAST. THE SRN EXTENT OF STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL SUPPORT SWD DEVELOPMENT INTO THE EASTERN PART OF THE AUSTIN/SAN ANTONIO CWA AND PARTS OF THE HOUSTON CWA THROUGH THE EVENING AND OVERNIGHT. WHILE THERE WILL BE SOME INCREASE IN LOW-LEVEL SHEAR ACROSS THIS REGION SUPPORTING SOME TORNADO THREAT...DAMAGING WINDS SHOULD BE THE GREATER SEVERE WEATHER THREAT AS SUGGESTED BY 12Z 4 KM WRF-NMM/WRF-NSSL EACH SHOWING QLCS/BOWING STRUCTURES THROUGH 07-09Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR ALL SVR HAZARDS CONTINUES ACROSS TOR WATCH 519. PRIMARY THREAT IS CURRENTLY DAMAGING WINDS WITH THE THREAT FOR TORNADOES WITHIN THE LINE INCREASING AS THE LOW-LEVEL JET INCREASES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LINE OF STRONG TO SVR TSTMS CURRENTLY STRETCHES FROM SE MO SWD THROUGH AR THEN SWWD INTO CNTRL TX. CURRENT RADAR IMAGERY SUGGESTS THE MOST PROMINENT DAMAGING-WIND THREAT EXISTS ACROSS AR WHERE SEVERAL BOWING SEGMENTS EXIST. FORWARD MOTION OF THE SYSTEM ACROSS AR IS BETWEEN 35 AND 45 KT. ACTIVITY NEAR CONWAY COUNTY HAS RECENTLY SURGED FORWARD. DAMAGING WIND THREAT IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. ADDITIONALLY...AREA VAD PROFILES SHOW THE LOW-LEVEL JET IS BEGINNING TO INCREASE ACROSS THE REGION. AS THIS OCCURS...LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL INCREASE WITH A RESULTANT INCREASE IN THE POSSIBILITY OF VORTICES EMBEDDED WITHIN THE LINE. ..MOSIER.. 10/03/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS REMAINS THE PRIMARY THREAT ACROSS PART OF SERN MO THROUGH SRN IL...WHICH HAS RESULTED IN A PORTION OF WW 517 IN PAH COUNTY WARNING AREA TO BE EXTENDED TEMPORALLY UNTIL 04Z. FARTHER EAST INTO SWRN INDIANA...A MORE STABLE ENVIRONMENT SUGGESTS THE OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH AS THE QLCS REACHES THIS REGION AFTER 04-05Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED THE NRN EXTENT OF GREATER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE REMAINED OVER SRN IL WHICH HAS RESULTED IN A SLOWER STABILIZATION PROCESS...DESPITE THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING...WITH MUCAPE TO AROUND 1000 J/KG. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 35-40 KT WITH VECTORS ORIENTED PARALLEL TO QLCS SHOULD SUSTAIN STORM ORGANIZATION UNTIL THE ENVIRONMENT UNDERGOES EVENTUAL STABILIZATION AND/OR THE QLCS MOVES EAST INTO AN AREA OF GREATER STABILITY EAST OF SRN IL. ..PETERS.. 10/03/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND SMALL/BRIEF TORNADOES WILL PERSIST ACROSS WW 519. A DOWNSTREAM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED AS THE CURRENT ACTIVITY CONTINUES EWD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT RADAR IMAGERY HAS SHOWN A SURGE IN THE LINE ACROSS MONROE....ARKANSAS...AND LINCOLN COUNTIES WITH ESTIMATED STORM MOTION OVER 50 KT. AT THAT SPEED...THIS PORTION OF THE LINE IS EXPECTED TO REACH THE ERN EXTENT OF WW 519 AROUND 0330Z. LZK RADAR IMAGERY HAS DEPICTED NUMEROUS MESO-VORTICES WITHIN THIS PORTION OF THE LINE WITH A CONTINUING THREAT FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS...SOME POTENTIALLY IN EXCESS OF 65 KT...AND SMALL/BRIEF TORNADOES. OTHER PORTIONS OF THE LINE ACROSS NE AR AND SE AR/N-CNTRL LA ARE ALSO STRONG TO SVR. NRN PORTION /NE AR/ OF THE LINE IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY WEAKEN AS IT ENCOUNTERS AN INCREASINGLY UNFAVORABLE AIRMASS. ADDITIONALLY...WEAKENING OF THIS PORTION OF THE LINE WILL BE HASTENED AS THE CNTRL PORTION OF THE LINE CONTINUES TO ACCELERATE AND INTERCEPTS THE BETTER LOW-LEVEL INFLOW. LOW-LEVEL INFLOW WILL REMAIN FAVORABLE ACROSS SRN PORTIONS OF THE LINE /SE AR AND N-CNTRL LA/ WITH THE SVR THREAT EXPECTED TO REMAIN WITHIN WW 519 UNTIL AROUND 0500Z. ..MOSIER.. 10/03/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WIND GUSTS REMAIN A SEVERE WEATHER THREAT ACROSS THE VALID PORTION OF WW 520. A NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH IS LIKELY TO THE EAST OF THIS WATCH TO INCLUDE FAR SERN TX INTO THE REST OF CENTRAL AND SRN LA...AND A SMALL PART OF SRN MS. COUNTIES AND PARISHES IN THE WAKE OF THE QLCS CAN BE CANCELLED WITH THE PASSAGE OF THESE STORMS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 04Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED THE SRN EXTENT OF A WELL-DEFINED E/SEWD MOVING QLCS EXTENDING FROM FAR SERN AR THROUGH NRN LA INTO EAST-CENTRAL TO SOUTH-CENTRAL TX. TRENDS SUGGEST SECTIONS OF THIS LINE FROM WALKER TO ANGELINA COUNTIES TX ARE MOVING ESEWD AROUND 40 KT....WHILE THE NRN LA PORTION IS TRACKING TO THE SOUTHEAST AT 35 KT. THE ENVIRONMENT DOWNSTREAM OF WW 520 INTO CENTRAL/SRN LA...ADJACENT SRN MS AND SERN TX REMAINS VERY MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE...WITH THE AFOREMENTIONED SPEED OF THE QLCS SUGGESTING THE THREAT FOR MAINLY DAMAGING WINDS WILL EXIT WW 520 BY 05Z. GIVEN THE FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMICS AND STRONG EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR FOR SUSTAINING STORM ORGANIZATION WITH EPISODIC FASTER FORWARD MOVEMENT OF THE LINE AT TIMES...A NEW WW WILL BE WARRANTED TO THE EAST OF WW 520. FARTHER SOUTH-SOUTHWEST INTO THE SRN EXTENT OF WW 520...A SLOWER MOVEMENT /AROUND 30 KT/ OF THE LINE MAY LIMIT THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT...THOUGH THE POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR TSTMS TO PERSIST...REACHING THE MIDDLE TX COAST AFTER 06Z WHERE THE ENVIRONMENT REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS...SOME SIGNIFICANT GUSTS...A COUPLE OF TORNADOES PERSISTS ACROSS WW 521 AND THE NRN PART OF WW 519. AS STORMS EXIT THE NRN PART OF WW 521 BETWEEN 06-07Z...A MORE STABLE ENVIRONMENT INTO MIDDLE TN AND NRN AL SHOULD LIMIT THE EWD EXTENT OF THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT. HOWEVER...TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A POTENTIAL ISSUANCE OF A NEW WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IS PRESENT ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY TO THE LOWER TN VALLEY...WHILE INSTABILITY REMAINED THE GREATEST WITH SWD EXTENT INTO CENTRAL/SRN MS AND LA. ALTHOUGH INSTABILITY IS WEAKER ACROSS NRN MS...WRN TN AND WRN KY...STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT SHOULD CONTINUE TO COMPENSATE FOR THIS LIMITING THERMODYNAMIC FACTOR THROUGH AT LEAST 07Z. AND...STRONG 0-1 KM SRH /300-400 M2 PER S2/ PER GWX AND HPX VADS WITHIN A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A TORNADO THREAT...ESPECIALLY FROM NRN MS TO WRN KY. THE PORTION OF THE QLCS MOVING INTO CENTRAL/SRN MS WAS TRACKING ESEWD AT 30-35 KT. GIVEN STRONGER INSTABILITY ACROSS THIS REGION...A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND/OR AN EMBEDDED QLCS TORNADO THREAT PERSISTS ACROSS THIS PORTION OF WW 521.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SQUALL LINE OVERSPREADING THE REGION MAY CONTINUE TO BE ACCOMPANIED BY THE RISK FOR LOCALIZED STRONG WIND GUSTS...PERHAPS A TORNADO. HOWEVER...WITH SUBSTANTIVE FURTHER INTENSIFICATION OF THE LINE APPEARING UNLIKELY...AND WEAKENING TRENDS EXPECTED BY OR SHORTLY AFTER 09-11Z...A WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE MOST VIGOROUS LINGERING SEGMENT OF THE ONGOING EASTWARD ADVANCING SQUALL LINE IS IN THE PROCESS OF PROGRESSING NORTHEAST AND EAST OF TORNADO WATCH 521...INTO SOUTH CENTRAL KENTUCKY/MIDDLE TENNESSEE AND NORTHERN ALABAMA. THIS ACTIVITY APPEARS TO CORRESPOND WITH STRONGER MID-LEVEL FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION ASSOCIATED WITH THE SIGNIFICANT SHORT WAVE IMPULSE NOW BEGINNING TO ACCELERATE NORTHEAST OF THE OZARK PLATEAU...TOWARD THE GREAT LAKES REGION. AIDED BY INFLOW OF MOIST UNSTABLE AIR /WITH CAPE PROBABLY ON THE ORDER OF 500 TO 1000 J PER KG/ STORMS HAVE BEEN MAINTAINING STRENGTH...AND THIS COULD PERSIST ANOTHER COUPLE OF HOURS ACROSS AND EAST OF THE BOWLING GREEN KY...NASHVILLE TN AND HUNTSVILLE AL AREAS. HOWEVER...BEYOND THE 09-11Z TIME FRAME...IT APPEARS THE SUPPORTING FORCING FOR ASCENT MAY BEGIN TO WEAKEN ACROSS KENTUCKY/TENNESSEE...AND THE CONTINUED EASTWARD PROGRESSION THE SQUALL LINE WILL INCREASINGLY CUT-OFF THE NORTHWARD RETURN OF BETTER MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY TO THE OHIO VALLEY. SO SUBSTANTIVE FURTHER INTENSIFICATION SEEMS UNLIKELY. HOWEVER...UNTIL ACTIVITY WEAKENS...STRONG LOW-LEVEL SHEAR BENEATH THE 40-50 KT SOUTHERLY 850 JET CORE ACROSS MIDDLE TENNESSEE INTO CENTRAL KENTUCKY MAY CONTINUE TO CONTRIBUTE TO THE RISK FOR SPORADIC DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...PERHAPS AN ISOLATED TORNADO.
